interface_note: Dual-MPC root-assisted G1 MuJoCo visualization based on the g1_ab_simulation walking scaffold. Body and task commands come from normalized interaction MPCs, and the body MPC uses the Kalman-style random-walk disturbance observer in normalized_mpc.py. The free root is kinematically assisted and the position-actuated G1 executes alternating one-foot swing commands. This should not be reported as torque-level dynamic walking validation or a valid fall test.
